sloka: अयम् च अत्र मया दृष्टः पर दार परिग्रहः ।तस्य प्रादुर् अभूच् चिन्ता पुनर् अन्या मनस्विनः ॥५-११-३९॥
transliteration: ayam ca atra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ para dāra parigrahaḥ ।tasya prādur abhūc cintā punar anyā manasvinaḥ ॥5-11-39॥

translations.english: Another bright idea struck the highly sensible Hanuman, who had a clear vision of the task ahead-- 'I was firm and singleminded in my direction regarding the task ahead' (thought he).
